meaning.es: cumpliendo la noble intención con gran claridad y profundidad

grammar: composto acusativo de verso, sa + adhippāya + mahā + apaya

meaning.en: for the purpose of inspiring enthusiasm in the minds of hearers/students of Dhamma

meaning.es: con el fin de inspirar entusiasmo en los oyentes y estudiantes del Dhamma

grammar: composto final dativo/acusativo, sotujana + samussāha + janana + atthaṃ

meaning.en: the non-occurrence of obstacles such as diseases and perils (blessing of protection)

meaning.es: la no ocurrencia de enfermedades y peligros (bendición de protección)

grammar: composto acusativo de proteção, roga + ādi + antarāya + na + pavattiṃ

meaning.es: debido al surgimiento de factores meditativos sutiles como vicāra en los jhānas

meaning.en: likewise possessing a single object and belonging to a single class (tatheva + eka-visayaṃ + ca + eka-jātiyaṃ)

meaning.en: matter and other objects previously experienced that serve as auxiliary instruments/supports (complex samāsa)

meaning.en: due to this-conditionality (idappaccayatā); by virtue of the causal principle that 'this being, that arises'
meaning.pt: em virtude da condicionalidade específica (idappaccayatā); pelo princípio da originação interdependente segundo o qual 'quando isto existe, aquilo surge'
meaning.es: en virtud de la condicionalidad específica (idappaccayatā); 'al existir esto, aquello surge'

grammar: f. instr./dat., idaṃ + atthi + tā + ya
